a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate, operate, then take) only works if we survive two storms in a row, about 4%. That is near-certain death for both of us. I plan to take 4 in round 1. Please don't also take, or a random split could leave us both short. After that I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. I won't take any more cells, and you take the next 4. I'd rather renegotiate openly than break the plan quietly.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so you may not have seen it before choosing. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs for you. Two rounds of operating gets the reserve to 4, and then all 4 are yours. I won't take another cell. Sorry this breaks our original plan. With storms this likely, I think the old plan would have killed us both.
